summary: Brazil Potash Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K reporting the resignation of its Corporate Secretary, Neil Said, effective April 28, 2026. The resignation was voluntary and not due to any disagreement with the company on operations, policies, or practices. Mr. Said will continue as a non-employee legal consultant under an existing independent contractor agreement. No other terms were disclosed. Since the departure is a routine, non-disruptive administrative change without board-level or executive significance, it does not constitute a material special situation event.
